summary: Master Big Data analytics for central banking. Learn SupTech, nowcasting, and ML to enhance monetary policy and financial stability. Enroll today.
lede: Big Data in Central Banking applies high-volume, high-velocity, and high-variety data to monetary policy and financial supervision. This 10-day training shows professionals how to use satellite imagery, web-scraping, and granular transaction records to develop timely indicators, improve forecasts, and monitor systemic risk. You will build nowcasting models for GDP and inflation, practice automated data validation and sentiment analysis, and explore SupTech, RegTech, SDMX®, and network analysis. The program also addresses practical challenges including data privacy, legacy system integration, cloud-based data lakes, and limited access to specialized data science talent.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals within central banks, regulatory bodies, and international financial institutions who are tasked with modernizing data infrastructure and policy analysis.
modules: Evolution of Central Bank Data Ecosystems
Natural Language Processing for Policy Communication
Network Analysis for Systemic Risk Assessment
Big Data in Payment Systems and CBDC
Climate Risk and ESG Data Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of macroeconomic principles and basic statistical methods. Familiarity with central bank operations and experience using data analysis tools (such as Excel, R, or Python) is recommended but not mandatory for all modules.
